task: Decide and document the stale-plugin-root failure mode (issue #3332)

events.content: Weighed the launcher-guard proposal in issue #3332 against documenting the failure mode, and shipped the documentation.

lessons: Before building a diagnostic, read the message the failure already prints. Here it already carried the path, so the whole delta was one sentence of missing runtime-contract knowledge, which is a documentation shape, not a code shape.
